about: Starter P1 "From the driver's seat" on the opening-local-dry-van-hourly brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

brief.subject: Class A local dry van driver

recipe.name: From the driver's seat
recipe.hook_formula: Say plainly what the run is, as if from the driver's seat: the lanes or the area, then the schedule or home time the brief states. If the brief states no lanes or area, say the kind of run (local, regional, over the road). Then what we need, if the brief states it (experience, licence, endorsements). No pay figure in the hook unless the brief states nothing else.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield from the driver's seat, {viewpoint}, an open {road} ahead through {setting}, {light}, {weather}, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: 360 Logistics runs dry van freight to Chicagoland stores on a dedicated local route. You are home every day. Pay starts at $28 per hour and goes to $32 per hour. You need 2 years of Class A experience and must be 23+. Paid time off included. Join our team.
en.headline: 360 Logistics is hiring
